meta.hyde: OFF — deliberately, so the two arms share one query vector (see the docstring)

power.why_it_matters: the pool is the production mmr_candidates pool and is far larger than the top-k cut, so unlike §G1's ablation the cut bites and the metric CAN move. The lane is RECALL-ONLY, so the POOL endpoint is the one it can actually move; read `contribution` for whether any DA chunk survives at all.

reranker_swallow.why_it_matters: ClusterCrossEncoderReranker.rerank swallows every failure and returns the pool UNRANKED (reranker.py:131-141), which makes the top-k comparison inert by construction for that query — the DA-added chunks sit last in the pool, so an unranked top-20 is always dense. §I55; rate measured by reranker_payload_probe.py.
